nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

**Key inputs**

- **prompt**: describe the shots, camera moves, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

```
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   └── 📂 text_encoders/
│       └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

widgets_values:
## Motion Context at both H3 stages

S2/S3 receive the previous segment's 22-frame AV latent tail twice: once at the 0.3MP first pass and again from the previous segment's 0.7MP refined latent before the six-step denoise=0.30 sampler. This keeps the quality branch while preventing each refine pass from independently redrawing the join. Only the existing 22-frame head is trimmed after decode. Final total remains 370 frames at 24fps.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D hand-drawn Japanese fantasy animation inspired by the warmth, wonder, and richly painted naturalism of classic Miyazaki films, presented as one uninterrupted eye-level medium-wide shot in a sunlit countryside kitchen. A fully clothed young adult woman with short dark hair, a cream blouse, moss-green overalls, and a red ribbon kneels beside an old wooden table while a tiny round forest spirit with leaf-shaped ears peeks from a wicker basket. Soft watercolor backgrounds, expressive pencil linework, gentle cel shading, and subtle hand-painted texture remain consistent. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed. From 0.00 to 1.30 seconds, she notices the basket rustling, smiles, and places a small red apple on the floor. From 1.30 to 4.30 seconds, the shy spirit climbs out, sniffs the apple, and rolls it toward her with both paws as dust motes drift through golden window light. From 4.30 to 5.17 seconds, she reaches toward the apple while the spirit tilts its head, ending in a stable pose that continues directly into the next segment. Preserve character designs, clothing, basket, table, window, lighting, camera height, and spatial relationships. Avoid violence, horror, and photorealism, identity drift, camera jump, scene change, morphing, duplicate limbs, cuts, text, logos, or watermarks.

overall_soundscape: Summer cicadas hum beyond the open window above soft birdsong and a light breeze in the leaves. The basket wicker creaks, the apple rolls across wooden floorboards, fabric rustles gently, and the small spirit chirps once at the segment boundary.

non_diegetic_music: A light waltz at a moderate tempo played by celesta, pizzicato strings, and wooden flute, continuing softly across the segment boundary.
